subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional append?: boolean on the existing write tool, or require a different model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The need for an append primitive is well supported, but the permanent write-tool API shape is a maintainer-owned product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve append?: boolean on write as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land after current-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a dedicated append tool
options.body: Ask the branch to split append into a separate model-facing tool if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Pause for a replacement only with proof
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if a narrower replacement proves the same behavior with stronger proof and a safer review surface.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve append?: boolean on write as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land after current-head CI and owner review are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history signal for agent runtime and tool API direction among the likely owners.
